services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: Offices are located at the South Entrance of the Extraco Events Center, off Bosque Blvd. Please note that the Box Office is not Staffed year-round. The Box Office will be open 2 hours prior to the start of an event. Tickets that are bought through third party vendors, and not directly through our Site, may not be valid for entry into the event. Event Tickets are sold exclusively online through this site
